scenes.tts: Most of the time we hear without really listening. When we sit still and listen, the backyard fills up with sounds. Ears catch them like funnels, and cupped hands make a bigger funnel.
scenes.narration: Most of the time we hear without really listening. When we sit still and listen, the backyard fills up with sounds. Ears catch them like funnels, and cupped hands make a bigger funnel.

scenes.tts: You need paper and crayons or pencils, a timer, such as a phone, and a towel or mat to sit on outside.

items.text: A timer, such as a phone

scenes.narration: You need paper and crayons or pencils, a timer, such as a phone, and a towel or mat to sit on outside.

scenes.tts: Pick a quiet spot away from roads and water. Ask how many sounds your child expects, and write the number down. Set the timer for two minutes. Your child closes their eyes and holds up one finger for each new sound.
scenes.narration: Pick a quiet spot away from roads and water. Ask how many sounds your child expects, and write the number down. Set the timer for two minutes. Your child closes their eyes and holds up one finger for each new sound.

scenes.tts: Expect anything from a few sounds to a dozen or more. Then your child cups both hands behind the ears. Most children hear it louder. Cupped hands catch more sound, like a cat's big ears.

items.text: A few sounds to a dozen
Hands catch more sound, like cat ears

scenes.narration: Expect anything from a few sounds to a dozen or more. Then your child cups both hands behind the ears. Most children hear it louder. Cupped hands catch more sound, like a cat's big ears.

scenes.tts: Stay close enough to touch. Cup hands only for quiet or everyday sounds, never toward a road. Nothing goes into the ear.
